lines.english: “What...?”

lines.japanese: 目が覚めると朝だった。
lines.english: When I opened my eyes, it was morning.

lines.japanese: 朝食は……小鳩が呼びに来てないのだから、たぶんまだなんだろう。日曜といえど規則正しい生活を送る、僕の妹は良い子。
lines.english: Breakfast... Kobato had not come to call me, so it was probably not ready yet. Even on Sundays, my little sister kept regular hours. What a good girl.

lines.japanese: あらためて机の上を見る。思ったよりも作業は進んでいた。だらだらマイペースでこなしたけど、一晩かけたからそれなりの成果になったみたい。
lines.english: I looked over the desk again. I had accomplished more than expected. I had worked lazily and at my own pace, but a whole night had produced respectable results.

lines.japanese: さて、今日はどうしよう。
lines.english: Now, what should I do today?

lines.japanese: なんとなく気だるいけれど、思考はクリアな正午前。部屋の掃除か、パソコンのデータ整理か。ああ、そういえば洗剤が切れそうだったっけ、小鳩の代わりに買ってこようかな。
lines.english: It was not yet noon. My body felt vaguely languid, but my mind was clear. I could clean the room or organize the files on my computer. Ah—we were almost out of detergent. Perhaps I could buy some for Kobato.

lines.japanese: 第一に為すべきことが厳然と存在するのに、あえて第二第三の課題を見出そうとするのは一種の逃避なんだろうか。
lines.english: When the first and most pressing duty stood plainly before me, was my determination to invent a second and third merely a form of escape?

lines.japanese: なんとはなしにシャーペンを手に取り、適当なメモ紙の上へ滑らせだした。
lines.english: Without any particular intention, I picked up a mechanical pencil and let it wander over a scrap of notepaper.

lines.japanese: その軌跡が恣意性のない曲線から意味のある文字へと変わりはじめたとき、小さくドアをノックするあの音がようやく届けられた。
lines.english: Just as its aimless curves began to assume the meaning of letters, the long-awaited little knock finally arrived at my door.

lines.japanese: ああ、朝ごはんだ。
lines.english: Ah. Breakfast.

lines.japanese: もう空の色が変わりはじめていた。
lines.english: The sky had already begun to change color.

lines.japanese: とくに日曜日の予定なんてないのだけど、貴重な安息日を学校行事の一環に費やしてしまったのはちょっと勿体ない気もする。
lines.english: I had no particular plans for Sunday, yet it felt a little wasteful to have spent my precious day of rest on a school function.

lines.japanese: でも、やっぱり、出来上がってくると嬉しいもんだな。
lines.english: Still, watching the finished thing take shape was gratifying.

lines.japanese: 机でインスタントコーヒーを啜りながら、卒業文集のインデックスを眺める。
lines.english: I sipped instant coffee at my desk and examined the index of the graduation anthology.

lines.japanese: ふと出席番号の一番最後に目が止まった。うちのクラスにワ行姓の女子はひとりしかいない。
lines.english: My eyes came to rest on the final name in attendance order. There was only one girl in our class whose surname began with W.

lines.japanese: 僕は渡来さんの部屋での出来事を思いだした。
lines.english: I remembered what had happened in Watarai’s room.

lines.japanese: グレタガルドでの解決策は見つけたけど、今度はいつ召喚されるのかな。
lines.english: I had found a solution for Gretagard, but when would I next be summoned?

lines.japanese: それから……あした渡来さんと顔を合わせたとき、まず何を話そう。
lines.english: And then... when I saw Watarai tomorrow, what should I say first?

lines.japanese: まさかみんなの前で堂々とってわけにもいかないし、困ったな。
lines.english: I could hardly speak openly in front of the entire class. This was difficult.

lines.japanese: 頬杖をついて思案していると、一階のテレビの音が耳に忍びこんでくる。
lines.english: As I propped my cheek on one hand and pondered, the sound of the television downstairs slipped into my ears.

lines.japanese: こらー待ちなさーい。うへえ、許して姉すゎーん。ハァーイ、バァブゥ～。
lines.english: “Hey! Get back here!” “Aah, have mercy, Siiis!” “Hiii! Ba-boo!”
“Haaah...”

lines.japanese: 窓の向こう、大きな空を眺めたら白い雲が飛んでいた。思わず溜息が漏れた。もうそんな時間か。
lines.english: Beyond the window, white clouds flew across an immense sky. A sigh escaped me before I knew it. Was it that late already?

lines.japanese: また今週も無駄な休日を送ってしまった。またやり直したいな。また明日も日曜だったらいいのに。
lines.english: Once again, I had squandered an entire holiday. I wanted another chance. If only tomorrow could be Sunday all over again.

lines.japanese: そもそも月曜なんてものを楽しみにしてるのは、よっぽど部活熱心なひとか、週末のサロンでお気に入りの髪型にしてもらった女の子くらいだと思う。
lines.english: Surely the only people who looked forward to Mondays were fanatical club members and girls who had gotten their hair done just the way they liked it at a salon over the weekend.

lines.japanese: 僕はコーヒーカップを置いてまぶたを閉じた。
lines.english: I set down my coffee cup and closed my eyes.

lines.japanese: まだまだ頑張らなきゃ終わらないんだけど、ちょっとだけ、五分だけでいいから、頑張ることをやめたいんだ。
lines.english: There was still far too much work left to finish. Still, for a little while—for only five minutes—I wanted to stop trying.

lines.japanese: 重力の赴くままに任せてみた。
lines.english: I surrendered myself to gravity.

lines.japanese: 「はっ、ここはどこだ？」
lines.english: “Hah! Where am I?”

lines.japanese: 気がついたときには、私の体は転生の地を離れ、翼人兵たちとの決着迫るグレタガルドに到着していた。
lines.english: By the time awareness returned, my body had left the land of my rebirth and arrived in Gretagard, where the final reckoning with the Winged Soldiers drew near.

lines.japanese: この森はいつか見たことのある。そうだ、ここは……。
lines.english: I had seen this forest once before. Yes, this was...

lines.japanese: 「ホーク卿」
lines.english: “Sir Hawk.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、君はスパロウじゃないか。君がいるということは、ここは以前召喚されたナハト村なのか」
lines.english: “Ah, Sparrow. If you are here, then this must be Nacht Village, where I was summoned before.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、その通りです。ホーク卿が修道院から逃れて、今はこの世界に身の置き場がないと聞いてお呼びしました」
lines.english: “Yes, it is. I heard that you escaped the monastery and now had nowhere left to shelter in this world, so I summoned you.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、もう私の罪を知らぬ者はいないのだな……」
lines.english: “I see. There is nobody left who does not know of my crime...”

lines.japanese: 「ふっ、この“黄金の鷹”聖騎士ホークともあろう者が、今となっては反逆者の烙印を捺され、かつての仲間たちに負われる始末。この身を笑ってくれ、スパロウ」
lines.english: “Hmph. To think that I, the Golden Hawk, holy knight Hawk Cyan-Blue, should now bear the brand of traitor and flee my former comrades. Laugh at what I have become, Sparrow.”

lines.japanese: 「盛者必衰は世の常だよ」
lines.english: “All who flourish must fall. Such is the way of the world.”

lines.japanese: 「だが翼人兵たちの最後の砦、水鏡の塔を攻略するまでは、私は罪を償うことも許されない」
lines.english: “Yet until I conquer the Winged Soldiers’ final stronghold, the Tower of the Water Mirror, I am not even permitted to atone for my crime.”

lines.japanese: 「それも王宮騎士団の助力も得られぬ今となっては、戦うための仲間を集めることもできないじゃないか……」
lines.english: “And now, without the aid of the royal knights, I cannot even gather companions for the battle...”

lines.japanese: 無論私は己の身がどうなろうと構わない。ただ、残されたグレタガルドの民のことだけが気がかりだ。
lines.english: Naturally, I cared nothing for what became of me. My sole concern was for the people of Gretagard who remained.

lines.japanese: 私は割れよとばかりに、大地に拳をがつんがつんと打ち付けた。
lines.english: Again and again I drove my fist into the earth as though I meant to split it.

lines.japanese: 「私でよければ、ホーク卿と共に戦わせてください」
lines.english: “If you will have me, let me fight beside you, Sir Hawk.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いやしかし……水鏡の塔は翼人兵たちが篭る強力な要塞。命すら失うかもしれないのに、共に来てくれると言うのか」
lines.english: “N-no. The Tower of the Water Mirror is a mighty fortress occupied by the Winged Soldiers. You may lose your very life. Will you still come with me?”

lines.japanese: 「はい、あなたとグレタガルドのためならば」
lines.english: “Yes. For you and for Gretagard.”

lines.japanese: 「礼を言う……っ」
lines.english: “You have my thanks...!”

lines.japanese: 私はその頼もしい仲間を抱きしめようと歩みよった。
lines.english: I stepped forward to embrace my steadfast companion.

lines.japanese: 「おおっと、俺のことを忘れてもらっちゃ困るぜ！　もちろん最後の戦いには俺も連れていってくれるんだろうな、我が友ホーク？」
lines.english: “Whoa there! Don’t forget about me! Naturally you’ll take me along for the final battle, won’t you, my friend Hawk?”

lines.japanese: 「ふっ、君が来てくれると必ず信じていたさ、ペガサス。そこの木陰から自慢の長髪が見えていたぞ？」
lines.english: “Hmph. I knew you would come, Pegasus. I could see your celebrated mane peeking out from behind that tree.”

lines.japanese: そう、私は我が朋友に歩みよって、彼の無事と友情を確かめつつがっちりと抱きしめた。
lines.english: Yes. I went to my dear friend and embraced him firmly, assuring myself both of his safety and of the bond between us.

lines.japanese: 「おっと、バレちまっていたか……へへっ、驚かそうとしたつもりが、とんだ失敗だったな」
lines.english: “So you saw me after all... Heh heh. I meant to surprise you, but that scheme was a miserable failure.”

lines.japanese: 「ペガサス……本当に無事でよかった。私は君の背信など欠片も信じていなかったぞ」
lines.english: “Pegasus... Thank heaven you are safe. I never believed for an instant that you had betrayed us.”

lines.japanese: 「もちろんだホーク。俺としたことが偽者の姫に騙され、偵察の極秘任務と信じて、のこのこ一人で翼人兵の砦に向かっちまった……まさかそれがおまえをも巻きこむ罠だったとはな」
lines.english: “Of course not, Hawk. Like a fool, I let an impostor princess deceive me. Believing I was on a secret reconnaissance mission, I marched alone straight to the Winged Soldiers’ fortress... I never imagined it was a trap meant to ensnare you as well.”

lines.japanese: 「修道院に戻ったところを、敵に通じたと疑った仲間たちに捕らえられ、今ようやくこうして繋がれていた獄から逃げてきたところさ。すまねえ、俺が王国を危機に……」
lines.english: “When I returned to the monastery, our comrades suspected me of conspiring with the enemy and seized me. I’ve only just escaped the prison where they held me in chains. I’m sorry. I placed the kingdom in peril...”

lines.japanese: 「いいんだペガサス、君が生きていてくれたのなら。もう失う物がなにもない私たちだ……」
lines.english: “It does not matter, Pegasus, so long as you live. We have nothing left to lose...”

lines.japanese: 「え、あるよあるある！」
lines.english: “What? Yes you do! Lots of things!”

lines.japanese: 「そうさ、ホーク！　俺たちにはまだ友情と誇りがあるぜ！」
lines.english: “That’s right, Hawk! We still have our friendship and our pride!”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、これは私としたことが迂闊だったな。フッ、たった二人なのに、百万の軍勢よりも頼もしく見える」
lines.english: “Of course. That was careless of me. Hmph. There are only two of you, yet you give me more heart than an army a million strong.”

lines.japanese: <8>\「さあ、行こう！　水鏡の塔を攻略するぞ！」
lines.english: “Come! We march upon the Tower of the Water Mirror!”

lines.japanese: 「イエーッ！　遥かなるグレタガルド、イエーッ！」
lines.english: “Yeeeah! Faraway Gretagard! Yeeeah!”

lines.japanese: さあ最後の砦、水鏡の塔に行こう。最強の武器天聖剣グレタマキシマイザーを手に入れ“魔空旅団”のボスを倒すんだ。
lines.english: To the Tower of the Water Mirror, the enemy’s final fortress. We would claim the supreme weapon, the Celestial Holy Sword Gretamaximizer, and strike down the leader of the Demon Sky Brigade.

lines.japanese: さあ、最後の戦いに挑もう！
lines.english: Come. Let the final battle begin!

lines.japanese: しゃんしゃんしゃんしゃん……
lines.english: Jingle, jingle, jingle, jingle...

lines.japanese: 「はっ、これからという時に……今回の冒険はここまでか」
lines.english: “Hah! Just as we were about to begin... So this adventure ends here.”

lines.japanese: どうやら戦いに向かう前に、私に残された時間が尽きたようだ。この続きはまた次回だな。
lines.english: It seemed my allotted time had expired before we could march to battle. The rest would have to wait until next time.

lines.japanese: それにしても、プリンセスが居なくても物語は成りたつものだなあ。
lines.english: Still, it appeared the story could function perfectly well without its princess.

lines.japanese: 物語？　なにを言ってるんだ、これは現実の世界なんだ……。
lines.english: A story? What was I saying? This was a real world...
